long_biography.plain_text:
Hadjieleftheriadis learned the trade at sea, graduating from Hydra’s Maritime School, serving in the Hellenic Navy and rising to captain. He later studied foreign trade in London while working evenings at N.J. Goulandris. Returning to Piraeus in 1969, he joined the family venture Eletson and became a driving force in its tanker business.

His influence extended beyond fleet management. Eletson ordered double-hull tankers before the Exxon Valdez disaster and later built an entirely double-hulled product-tanker fleet. Hadjieleftheriadis also promoted safety and seafarer training through HELMEPA, the Union of Greek Shipowners and Lloyd’s Register. His 2019 Lloyd’s List/Propeller Club lifetime award recognised a career that combined operating innovation with maritime education.
